summary: SmartDS ground truth and metric code are auditable, but all existing model results use the old graph=inf pipeline and no corrected v2 core experiment has completed.

gt_provenance.details: Targets come from LoadWindowDataset and SmartDS load_ts; no model-generated reference.

score_normalization.details: Metrics use inverse-normalized prediction/target; no self-referential normalization.

result_existence.details: 15 old result JSON files exist, but all are v4 graph=inf validation-only artifacts; v2 results are absent.

dead_code.details: Evaluation, gate diagnostics and new block-statistics paths are connected; old results lack block statistics.

scope.details: Corrected topology, dual-graph, federated and final-test blocks are not yet completed.

action_items: Run topology_forest, topology_mst_no_tag and topology_mst_tag with v2 code.
Run physical-only, functional-only and dual-graph ablations.
Run LocalOnly, FedAvg, FedProx and Personalized with at least three seeds.
Use analyze_results.py only when both result files have matching seed, split, block length and code revision.
